title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 52 (Rwai Jingieit Samla Vol. 8)
cultural_context: Expresses romantic affection and devotion along mountain paths. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
Ko Mei-rilung ba ieng rasong,
Ki wah ki tuid da ka kmen;
Ha pha ngi buh ia ka mynsiem,
Ban iada ia ka nam jong ka jaitbynriew.
lyrics_english:
O ancient mountain hills standing in majesty,
Where sparkling rivers cascade with delight;
In thee we place our steadfast spirit,
To defend the renown of our people.
